description: AT-26 Xavante FAB 4616 (c/n 80170413) inaugurated 12 Oct 2005 in this small town near Erechim (AeroFórum 2009; ABRAPAC 2019; Feb 2026 compilation). The same 2026 compilation also lists '4616' at the Museu Militar Brasileiro in Panambi - one of the two must carry a false or misread serial.
